body:
## Bevy version

0.7

## What you did

Cargo.toml
```toml
<snip>

[target.'cfg(target_arch="wasm32")'.dependencies]
lunatic = "0.9"
bevy = { version = "0.7", default-features = false }
```
.cargo/config.toml
```toml
[target.wasm32-wasi]
runner = "lunatic"
```

ran `cargo run --bin server --target wasm32-wasi`
